title: Huskclaims Gui Addon
description: This plugin adds a fully featured GUI and allows users easier operation.
body:
# HuskClaimGUI - An Unofficial GUI Addon

This is an **unofficial** addon for the **HuskClaim** plugin. It provides a comprehensive, configurable, and multi-language GUI menu for all essential player commands.

This plugin makes it significantly easier for players, especially new ones, to manage their claims without needing to memorize every command.

---

> ### IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER
> Please note: This is an **unofficial, community-created addon**. It was **not** made by, nor is it officially supported by, the developer of HuskClaim. It was developed as a supplement because the original plugin was not being actively maintained at the time of this GUI's creation.

---

### Features

* **Complete GUI Menu:** A clean menu for all player-facing commands, accessible via `/claimgui`.
* **Logical Categories:** Commands are sorted into "My Claims," "Friends & Trust," and "Manage Claim Blocks."
* **Interactive Commands:** Commands requiring arguments (e.g., `/trust <player>`) are suggested in the player's chat bar, allowing them to simply type the name and press enter.
* **Claim Shovel System:** A dedicated menu item gives players the claim shovel, complete with instructions and a configurable cooldown.
* **100% Configurable:** There are **no hard-coded texts**. Everything a player sees can be changed.
* **Multi-Language Support:** Ships with support for multiple languages right out of the box.

### Configuration & Customization

This plugin was built with the goal of allowing server owners to customize **everything**.

* **`config.yml`:** This file controls all logic and layout.
    * Set the active language (e.g., `language: "en"`).
    * Set the claim shovel cooldown (in seconds).
    * Change the `Material` for every single item in the menu.
    * Change the `slot` position for every item.
    * Change the size of the menus.

* **`locales/` Folder:** This is where all text is managed.
    * Change every menu title, item name, and item description (lore).
    * Customize all chat messages (like the cooldown message).
    * Easily add your own translations by copying and editing a file.

### Supported Languages

The plugin includes the following translations by default:
* **English (`en.yml`)**
* **German (`de.yml`)**
* **Spanish (`es.yml`)**
* **French (`fr.yml`)**

### Transparency Notice (Development)

> This plugin was originally developed for a private server (ValoriaSMP). While all user-facing elements (the plugin name, commands, chat messages) have been rebranded to the neutral `HuskClaimGui`, it is possible that you may find references to the original server name in the internal Java file names or package structure (e.g., `net.valoria...`).
>
> This has **absolutely no impact on the plugin's function or performance** and is a purely "cosmetic" detail within the source code. **Everything your players see is fully customizable.**

### Dependencies

* **HuskClaim** (Must be installed)
* **Paper** (or a Paper-based fork) for **Minecraft 1.20.1** (Spigot is **NOT** supported)

### Command

* `/huskclaimgui` (Alias: `/claimgui`)
